shape.description: Bright green ramp: a wide shallow trough on a blue two-cell base that looks like two fused low blocks, carried on short posts. The low end is a tongue at base height where a track arrives; the trough curves up along the base. Its far end is cut on a slant: one side wall rises into a pointed fin with a small round hole, the other ends lower in a curled lip resting on a post.
shape.sizeBasis: Estimated, not measured: cell about 62 mm and slot about 47 mm, from block width against a hand and marbles (IMG_0951, IMG_0952) and the plan drawing proportion slot/cell about 0.76. src/catalog/parts.js uses a 50 mm cell, also an estimate. Ratios to cell and slot are better known than the millimetres.

accepts: open air, marble flies to M-11
two supports side by side, as two blue blocks

physics.behaviour: Takes a fast marble from T-06 and tips it upward off the lip into the air. Adds no energy: the speed comes from M-01. A marble without enough speed rolls back. In the family build the marble must clear a stack, and in Extreme it must fly under a track bridge.

evidence.shows: Placement 1: T-06 from M-01 meets the low end; base on the floor two cells along. The lip faces M-11 across one empty floor cell, in the same line.

evidence.source: extreme_24 step 3-3, extreme_25 map, extreme_26 and extreme_73
evidence.shows: Placement 2: M-10 at B4-B5 with T-06 and M-01 behind it. Across the join to Part 1 it faces M-11; about 3 cells separate lip and ring, and a T-06 bridge crosses over the flight line. The box label prints T-10, a misprint of M-10.
Placement 3: base stands on two blue blocks side by side, lip faces M-11 over one cell holding an orange cup block on two blocks.
Real piece: dark blue two-wide base, light green ramp, posts visible.
Ramps need two supports side by side.
T-Rex set also lists M-10, count 1. Check whether it is the same mould; extracted_trex.json calls it a foot.

evidence.source: lp_plans_04 M-10 parts box and trex_plans_01 M-10
evidence.shows: trough of near-constant width; pointed fin with hole on one side of the high end, curled lip on a post on the other

assumptions: Origin at footprint centre at foot level (the top plane of whatever the piece stands on). East is +x, south is +y, z in slots.
Flow direction low to lip: M-01 feeds it, and the only part beyond is M-11.
Heights are from drawings: low seat 0.75 slot, lip 1.3 slots above the base foot. Base height and lip height were measured off lp_plans_15.
dropSlots is negative because the marble climbs.
Filename carries __5422 because T-Rex uses the same code.
